Location: Remote / Flexible

### Job Summary:
Seeking a world-class Ethical Hacker and Application Security Engineer to lead our offensive security initiatives. You will be responsible for end-to-end security testing of 25+ enterprise applications, driving DevSecOps integration, and identifying critical vulnerabilities before they reach production.

### Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the Application Security Team in various web and mobile application security testing projects.
- Perform deep source code analysis and web application penetration testing for high-stakes platforms.
- Integrate various security testing tools (SAST/DAST) into CI/CD pipelines to establish secure coding practices.
- Conduct threat modeling and cloud configuration reviews (AWS/GCP).
- Actively participate in Red Team operations and Bug Bounty programs.
- Report various vulnerabilities ranging from Critical to low level and oversee remediation efforts.

### Mandatory Technical Skills:
- Mastery of Penetration Testing and Vulnerability Assessment.
- Strong proficiency in Python, PHP, and Bash for security automation.
- Expertise in tools: Burp Suite, Acunetix, Checkmarx, SOAPUI, TrendMicro, and ThreadFix.
- Solid understanding of Network Pentesting, Ethical Hacking, and API Security.
- Experience with SIEM tools such as Splunk or McAfee.

### Professional Standing & Education:
- B. Tech in Computer Science or related engineering field.
- Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) or equivalent professional certification.
- Documented "Hall of Fame" or "Researcher Spotlight" status on major platforms like Bugcrowd, Hackerone, or Synack.
- Recognition from major global organizations (e.g., Skyscanner, Purevpn, DarkMatter) for vulnerability disclosure.

Location: Remote / Flexible

### Company Overview:
We are a cutting-edge AI automation firm developing production-ready agentic systems. We specialize in LLM orchestration and high-volume data processing at the scale of 500+ million records.

### Job Summary:
Seeking a visionary Senior AI/ML Engineer to lead the development of our core agentic frameworks. In this role, you will be responsible for deploying production-ready chatbots, and architecting data pipelines for advanced LLM automation, specifically focusing on Computer Use and Browser Use capabilities.

### Key Responsibilities:
- Design and implement end-to-end AI/ML infrastructure for data collection, ETL, and model deployment.
- Optimize and fine-tune large language models (LLMs) to enhance performance and reduce latency by significant margins.
- Lead the development of AI models for complex projects including autolabeling, speech recognition, and object tracking.
- Mentoring junior team members and providing technical leadership in AI engineering.
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical AI specifications.

### Mandatory Technical Skills:
- Mastery of Deep Learning Frameworks: TensorFlow, PyTorch.
- Advanced AI Libraries: LangChain, HuggingFace, Transformers, XGBoost, MLFlow.
- Specialized NLP: LLM fine-tuning, BERT, Sentiment Analysis, Sentence Autocomplete.
- Computer Vision: Classification, Object Detection, Deepfakes, Face Recognition.
- Backend & Data: Python, FastAPI, Flask, SQL, MongoDB.

### Education & Experience:
- Master’s or PhD in Computer Science or AI-related engineering field.
- Extensive experience (Senior level) in building production-grade AI systems.
- Proven experience processing extremely large datasets (500M+ customer records).
- Previous experience as a "Founding AI Engineer" or leading AI initiatives is highly desirable.

Category: Infrastructure & Platform Engineering
Location: Remote / International

### Job Summary:
Seeking a deeply experienced Senior DevOps Engineer and Infrastructure Manager (14+ years) to lead our cloud transformation and CI/CD automation strategies. You will be responsible for orchestrating end-to-end software delivery lifecycles, managing large-scale AWS infrastructure, and migrating complex on-premise application suites to the cloud with high availability.

### Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the management of production and non-production instances at scale across multiple global regions (APAC, EMEA, AMS).
- Develop fully automated Terraform and CloudFormation workflows for multi-resource provisioning and environment management.
- Architect and implement complex CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins (Groovy/PowerShell) and GitLab CI/CD.
- Oversee infrastructure security including security patching, OS updates, and DevSecOps integrations (SonarQube, Fortify).
- Set up and manage monitoring and logging infrastructure using ELK Stack, Splunk, and Dynatrace.
- Execute strategic migrations of on-premise applications to AWS with a focus on cost optimization and redundancy.

### Technical Skills & Tools:
- Cloud Platforms: Mastery of AWS services (S3, CloudFront, ACM, Route53, API Gateway, Lambda, ECS, IAM).
- IaC & Automation: Expert level Terraform, CloudFormation, Jenkins, Git.
- Operating Systems & Database: Linux (RHEL), Solaris, Windows, Oracle, Sybase, MSSQL, DynamoDB.
- Specializations: Unix Shell, PowerShell, and Python development for infrastructure automation.

### Experience & Education:
- 12+ years of experience in DevOps and Infrastructure Management.
- Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science & Engineering.
- Must hold multiple professional AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect, Developer, or Data Engineer).
- Proven track record of managing end-to-end IT infrastructure in fast-paced Agile environments.

Category: Mobile Development
Location: Remote / Los Angeles

### Job Summary:
Seeking a Senior Mobile Application Developer with 5+ years of experience in designing and developing high-performance mobile applications. You will be responsible for leading the development of complex cross-platform and hybrid applications, specifically focusing on healthcare integrations and secure data management.

### Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the development of mobile healthcare applications for iOS and Android using a mobile-first approach.
- Implement secure login features using OAuth and other advanced authentication protocols.
- Design and integrate complex features such as "Virtual ID Card" access and document management on mobile devices.
- Deliver high-quality hybrid applications using Cordova, Ionic, Angular, and React Native.
- Optimize application performance, aiming for significant reductions in load time and high user engagement metrics.
- Managing cross-platform migrations (e.g., from legacy jQuery mobile to Angular/Ionic frameworks).

### Technical Skills & Tools:
- Expert proficiency in JavaScript ES6, ES7+, and Java EE.
- Core Mobile Tech: React Native, Flutter, Ionic, Cordova, Angular.
- Backend Integration: RESTful APIs, JSON, AJAX, OAuth.
- Frontend: Responsive design with HTML5, CSS3, and modern JS frameworks.

### Education & Achievements:
- Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or related engineering field (University of California degree or similar recognized credential).
- Proven track record of increasing user engagement by 30%+ through app optimization.
- Strong portfolio of successfully deployed apps on the App Store and Google Play.

Category: Software Engineering
Location: Atlanta / Remote

### Job Summary:
Seeking a high-caliber Software Engineer with a strong Research & Development background to lead automated algorithm design and framework optimization. You will be responsible for developing evolutionary multi-objective engine frameworks and optimizing performance across high-performance computing (HPC) clusters.

### Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the development of Automated Algorithm Design frameworks (e.g., EMADE - Evolutionary Multi-objective Algorithm Design Engine).
- Implement multi-island models with dynamic migration topologies to improve population diversity in algorithmic solutions.
- Optimize framework performance to achieve significant improvements in convergence speed and objective coverage while reducing computational overhead.
- Architect high-performance web crawlers and full-stack job platforms processing large volumes of listings with minimal response time.
- Conduct Google-sponsored or similar high-level research in automated algorithm design.

### Technical Skills & Tools:
- Programming: Python, Java, R, C, MATLAB, JavaScript, TypeScript.
- Data & ML: Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain, Hugging Face, OpenCV.
- Web & Tools: React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Flask, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
- Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP.

### Education:
- Master of Science in Computer Science from a top-tier global university (Georgia Institute of Technology or equivalent).
- Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with a concentration in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning.
- Proven track record of high GPA (e.g., 3.9/4.0 or 4.0/4.0).

Category: Web Development
Location: Remote / International

### Job Summary:
Seeking a high-caliber Senior Backend Developer to architect and manage the server-side logic of our enterprise e-commerce platforms. You will be responsible for designing and structuring complex database architectures (MySQL/MongoDB), implementing scalable RESTful APIs, and ensuring maximum uptime for mission-critical services.

### Key Responsibilities:
- Design and structure server-side logic for high-performance ecommerce websites (e.g., Menemarket uz style).
- Build and deploy scalable backend infrastructures using Node.js, NestJS, and Express.js.
- Optimize database performance for MongoDB and MySQL at the scale of millions of entries.
- Lead the migration of legacy projects into modern microservices architectures.
- Collaborate with frontend teams to provide seamless API integrations and data flow.
- Successfully put complex web applications into production in fast-paced timelines.

### Technical Skills:
- Mastery of JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js.
- Backend Frameworks: NestJS, Next.js (API Routes), Ruby on Rails.
- Databases: MongoDB, MySQL, Redis.
- Documentation & Design: Figma, Git, and GitHub workflows.

### Experience:
- 5+ years of professional backend development experience.
- Strong track record of taking complex web projects from design to production.
---

Category: Web Development
Location: Remote / Flexible

### Job Summary:
Looking for a Senior Frontend Developer with a deep focus on user experience and responsive design. You will be responsible for building highly immersive web interfaces using modern frameworks like React and Vue, specifically focusing on performance optimization across browsers.

### Key Responsibilities:
- Develop highly responsive and interactive user interfaces using React.js and Next.js.
- Translate complex Figma designs into high-quality, maintainable code.
- Optimize web performance, achieving significant reductions in page load times and core web vitals.
- Lead the implementation of complex frontend features such as dynamic dashboards and e-commerce cart systems.
- Mentor junior frontend developers and establish best practices for CSS management (Tailwind/Sass).

### Technical Requirements:
- Expert level HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+).
- Proficiency in React.js, Redux, and modern state management.
- Experience with Next.js and Server-Side Rendering (SSR).
- Deep understanding of Responsive Web Design and cross-browser compatibility.

### Educational Profile:
- Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related design field.
- Strong portfolio of live web applications with high user engagement metrics.

Category: Web Development
Location: Remote / Flexible

### Job Summary:
Seeking a high-performance Full Stack Developer specializing in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js). You will be responsible for building responsive web applications, automating internal workflows, and optimizing website performance for enterprise client projects.

### Key Responsibilities:
- Design and develop full-stack workout trackers or similar complex applications using React, Node, and MongoDB.
- Implement secure JWT Authentication for granular user data access and secure login flows.
- Automate task generation for ticket raising systems using internal sync and API calling, improving operational efficiency.
- Manage client-led international projects (e.g., Deichmann Karriere), addressing bug fixes and implementing UX improvements to drive user engagement.
- Integrate billing systems and payment gateways (e.g., Stripe) for e-commerce platforms.
- Architect desktop-based applications using Java AWT/Swing when required.

### Technical Skills:
- Professional proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Wordpress, and Laravel.
- Backend Expertise: Node.js, Express.js, PHP, Java (JDBC).
- Frontend Expertise: React.js, UI/UX optimization, responsive design.
- Database: MySQL, MongoDB, XAMPP Server.
- Specialized NLP: Experience building sentiment analysis tools using Bag of Words or TF-IDF.

### Education & Achievements:
- Bachelor of Technology in Computer Engineering with a high CGPA (e.g., 9.2+).
- Strong track record on programming platforms like LeetCode and HackerRank (300+ questions).
- Qualified GATE (Computer Science) examination.
- Active participant in open-source contributions (e.g., HacktoberFest).

Category: Data Science & AI
Location: Los Angeles / Remote

### Job Summary:
Seeking an innovative Senior Data Scientist with 7+ years of experience in data analytics and machine learning. You will specialize in predictive modeling, hierarchical database design, and transforming complex data into strategic insights for business growth.

### Key Responsibilities:
- Develop predictive models and machine learning algorithms to analyze complex systems (e.g., chemical/biological datasets).
- Implement statistical techniques for data mining and enhanced database query accuracy.
- Architect and design hierarchical databases for efficient graph isomorphism searches, focusing on data retrieval optimization.
- Engineer new Artificial Neural Network (ANN) algorithms using advanced back-propagation techniques.
- Collaborate with engineering teams to produce clean, object-oriented code following software design best practices.
- Conduct rigorous statistical analysis to support high-stakes R&D initiatives.
- Implement pipelines for feature extraction using technologies like MapReduce.

### Technical Skills:
- Programming: Python, R, C, MATLAB.
- ML/AI: Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Statistical Modeling.
- Data Tools: Scikit-learn, SQL (Amazon AWS), MapReduce.
- Visualization: Advanced data visualization and BI reporting.

### Education:
- Master of Science in Data Science or Machine Learning from a premier global university (e.g., University of California, Berkeley).
- Strong track record of academic excellence in machine learning and statistical analysis.

Role: Senior HR Manager & TA Lead
Category: Human Resources
Location: Corporate Office

### Job Summary:
Seeking a Senior HR Manager to lead our talent acquisition and HR operations across a complex corporate group. You will be responsible for managing large-scale F&A teams, oversight of payroll compliance across multiple companies and trusts, and partnering with PE investors on consolidation and restructuring projects.

### Key Responsibilities:
- Lead and manage HR and Talent Acquisition for teams of 30+ employees including qualified professionals across multiple SBUs.
- Partner with C-suite executives and private equity investors (e.g., KKR level) on business consolidation, mergers, and due diligence.
- Formulate and implement group-wide HR policies, compliance frameworks, and performance management systems.
- Manage end-to-end employee lifecycles including large-scale internal communication and change management programs.
- Oversight of statutory audits, legal, and procurement functions as they relate to human resources.

### Requirements & Skills:
- 10+ years of experience in Human Resources management.
- Expertise in full-cycle recruitment, workforce planning, and talent pipe-lining.
- Proficiency in HRIS systems, legal compliance, and procurement functions.
- Strong strategic planning and business partnering capabilities.
- Deep experience in Managing large teams and conflict resolution.

### Education:
- MBA in Human Resources or related Management field.
- Background in leading HR for large MNCs or midsized listed companies is highly desirable.
